changelog: NEW Subject Tracker deep control for the AI agent: the achiva_mcp MCP server grew from 10 to 43 tools — the agent can now do everything in the subject tracker that you can do by hand
Chapters: update priority (Low/Medium/High), status (Not Started/In Progress/Completed), start/end dates, rename, delete
Topics: add topics and nested sub-topics, rename, imp/vvi tags, tick/untick with subtree, write per-topic detailed notes, delete
Sources: add/edit/delete Normal/PYQ question sources, mark solved/doubt/doubt-solved/analysis/important question numbers, 2/3/4+ attempt groups, important pages with topics
Roadmaps: add/edit/tick/delete chapter Complete & Mastery roadmap steps, plus the GLOBAL step templates (triangle icon) — add/rename/reorder/delete with auto-sync to every chapter

Revision system: chapter recall completion with 1-5 rating and automatic next-due scheduling, due-date adjust (app caps respected), question-revision completion via imp/att/pg keys, revision checklist step CRUD
Test Book + Error Book: log mock tests (type, subjects, chapters, marks, rank) and per-question mistakes with all 6 mistake types
Exams: update and delete (add already existed)
Deletes are SAFE by design: every achiva_delete_* tool is two-step — first call previews, the agent must ask you in chat, and only then can it delete with confirm=true
achiva_get_state now also returns tests, mistakes and global step templates, plus an enriched summary (chapter/topic/source counts, per-subject overview)
Bridge data safety: every mutation goes through Achiva's own live stores (ST.state + persist), mirroring the app's exact clamp/merge/migration behaviour — no raw storage writes
